## MANDATORY WATERMARK RULE

**Every image generated by the Paper Banana skill MUST include the `imgs/logo.png` watermark in one corner of the final output.** This applies to all output types:

- **Raster images** (PNG/JPG from `generate_figure.py`): Composite `imgs/logo.png` onto a corner of the image before saving.
- **Draw.io diagrams** (`generate_drawio.py`): Include an additional logo node anchored to a corner of the canvas.

This is a non-negotiable branding requirement. No generated figure should be produced without the Paper Banana logo watermark.
